question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

IMPECCABLE
solution:
The correct answer is:** Blemished**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Impeccable** means to describe something or someone without any flaws.

 
 
• **Example -** *A stand-up comedian needs **impeccable** timing for her jokes to work.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Blemished** means marked or spoiled by a flaw or by multiple flaws.
 
 
• **Example -** *The book is **blemished** by those long, ineffective descriptions.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that **'Impeccable'** and **'Blemished'** are **opposite** in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unsullied** means to be spotlessly clean and fresh.
 
• **Flawless** means without any imperfections or defects; perfect.
 
• **Exquisite** means extremely beautiful and delicate.
